children: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung instructed ministers at a Cabinet meeting on Thursday not to pursue an application to join the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) this year, the presidential office said.
The decision reflects concerns that membership would have a significant impact on South Korean farmers, the office said.
